message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V3.1.0 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**21 new caption looks as editable text clips**, **Auto Clipper**, a Graph Editor that shapes Premiere's own handles, and **83 new templates**.

*(Windows: quit Premiere Pro completely before you install. Then restart Premiere Pro once.)*

♦️ **New: 21 animated caption looks** (AutoCaptions › Look)
* Showcase, Open House, Skyline, Spark Count, Headline, Gilded, Velvet, Marquee, Cockpit, Orbit and more.
* **Output: Text clips**: every word is its own text clip on new tracks, editable in Essential Graphics. Your edit is never touched.

♦️ **New: Auto Clipper** (FX & ADV RIGS)
* Long video in, Shorts out: best moments → 1080x1920 sequences with captions, title + hashtags ready. Cloud or Local.

♦️ **New: Graph Editor KEYS = HANDLES / SMART / BAKED**
* **HANDLES** (default) puts your curve on Premiere's own keyframe handles: no keyframes in between.
* SMART adds only what elastic / bounce need. BAKED = the old way.

♦️ **New in Assets**
* 83 templates: 30 slideshows (Colorful, Dynamic, Modern Liquid) + 53 transitions (Cartoon, Liquid Motion, Neon, Seamless, Splash Liquid).

♦️ **Also**
* AutoCaptions Local mode: **FIX IT** button repairs Python / Whisper / ffmpeg.
* Tooltips off by default (Settings › Tooltips).
* **Download a section** no longer downloads the whole video when the Downloader app is installed.
